scripts.db:seed:local: npm run seed:gen && wrangler d1 execute techno-optimists --local --file packages/db/seed.sql
scripts.db:reset:local: npm run db:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:web && wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.deploy:prod: echo "prod is parked until the domain is bought - see wrangler.jsonc env.prod. To deploy anyway: npm run build:web && npx wrangler deploy --env prod" && exit 1
scripts.db:seed:dev: npm run seed:gen && wrangler d1 execute techno-optimists-dev --remote --file packages/db/seed.sql
scripts.db:reset:dev: npm run db:dev && npm run db:seed:dev
